observable: Thermal spread (mm) measured at 10mm from the active electrode during a 10-second electrosurgical procedure at 50W power setting
baseline: Current electrosurgical unit without thermal conductive reinforcement
conditions: Procedure performed on porcine tissue at room temperature (22°C) with a 10mm active electrode
falsifier: Failure to achieve a 30% reduction in thermal spread, or an increase in thermal spread by more than 10% compared to the baseline
